verdict.rationale: Solid says it is built on TypeScript and provides a TS template (solid-gh-15, solid-gh-22). Its tsconfig uses `"jsxImportSource": "solid-js"` (solid-gh-17), meaning Solid ships its own JSX type definitions that the standard TypeScript language service uses for completion and type errors. A community user notes TypeScript does not catch reactivity-losing destructuring (solid-comm-3), so some Solid-specific mistakes go unflagged in the editor. missing for 10: explicit documentation of editor/language-service support (autocompletion, inline diagnostics), any Solid-specific language tooling or lint integration, independent hands-on corroboration of editor DX quality.
